notes: Stop-to-stop service with no published zone outline, so only stops are drawn (like Cobourg, LT-Go and Spruce Grove). All points of the two official Google My Maps linked from the Ride CK OnRequest page ('bus stop locations'), retrieved 2026-11-14, used as published: Chatham 203 (202 signed stops + 1 virtual), Wallaceburg 54 (9 signed + 45 virtual). The page says trips run between any two designated stops within an urban area, so each town has its own trip rule. Hours per town from the page; Chatham lists no Saturday hours, so none are set. The page's 'Leave At may move 15 minutes later' and 45-minute ride-time notes are not shown. Open to everyone; separate from Ride CK specialized transit.
